text: ROUND 3 — DIO ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED with spec citation. Python parity (python/src/lichen/rpl/authenticated_dio.py:361) and spec 09-packets-timing.md §13.3 both mandate: authenticated DIOs are link-broadcast multicast to ff02::1a ONLY (unicast DIO destinations are rejected). But the root's DIS handler at main (receive.rs:576-580) responds to a UNICAST DIS with self.send_dio(source) — a unicast DIO — which the receiving leaf's (spec-correct) admission gate rejects => DioReceived never fires. PRODUCTION INCONSISTENCY: the gate and the DIS responder disagree. FIX (production, ~3 lines): unify the unicast-DIS path with the multicast-DIS path — trickle_reset(+multicast_dis_jitter) instead of send_dio(source) — so the DIS response is the canonical multicast DIO. TESTS: tests asserting immediate leaf DioReceived after a unicast DIS (tests.rs:1099 region and similar) must tick/receive across the deterministic jitter (multicast_dis_jitter helper) or drive the root's trickle until Transmit; the assertion strength stays (DioReceived, consistent). SEPARATE CAUSE ALERT: the DAO-flavored failures (dao_radio_failure_retains_exact_finalized_bytes, leaf_send_allocates_each_update, three_rpl_stacks, relay_forwards_original_source, rpl_dispatch_rejects) likely have their own gate condition (DAOs are inherently unicast — the multicast rule cannot apply to them; check whether 6008e4eed8/89cd460c0c over-applied the multicast requirement to the DAO path, or the DAO tests predate the DAO admission evidence rules). Diagnose those separately after the DIO fix lands. All diagnostic edits reverted; worktree ~/wt-0l4q warm.
